Introduction

IHOTEU is a independent live idol duo. They made their live debut on May 26, 2024, before releasing their debut digital single "The First Wave" on June 10, 2024.

On June 13th, Mina left the group due to the controversy with Lee Kanghee, CEO of JDB Entertainment (the agency that owns EFG Music). Later on June 14th it was announced that IHOTEU's exclusive contract with EFG Music was terminated upon a mutual decision.
